packageRules.description: No update PR before its release is 7 days old. pnpm-workspace.yaml sets the same wait (minimumReleaseAge), so a PR for a newer release could not resolve its lockfile anyway. Version pins (updateType pin) are left out, as in the pin rule below. Digest updates kept the 7-day wait they already had. Security-alert PRs skip this wait; one for a fix under 7 days old needs a minimumReleaseAgeExclude entry in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Minor, patch and digest updates automerge once the CI build job passes and the release is 7 days old. The build job runs typecheck, lint, workerd tests, build and a wrangler deploy dry run.
0.x and 1.0.0 prereleases stay manual, since any bump can break.
Pins have no release date, so the 7-day wait cannot apply. They stay manual.
CI installs pnpm from the pnpm/action-setup version input, and Node is the Worker build runtime. Both stay manual.

Overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml are security floors for transitive dependencies. A major bump forces the parent onto a version it may not support, so only minor and patch updates are proposed. Raise a floor's major by hand. Security-fix PRs still come through, because vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled is applied after packageRules.
For a 0.x floor (such as sharp@0) a minor bump is the breaking step, so it is blocked too.

Why ignoreDeps lists workers-oauth-provider-v0: it is a test-only npm alias pinned to @cloudflare/workers-oauth-provider 0.10.4 on purpose, so apps/gateway/test/oauth-v0-sessions.test.ts can create sessions with the old library and prove they still work on 1.x. Updating it would defeat that test. ignoreDeps also stops security-alert PRs, which bypass packageRules; this rule only records the reason.
